summary: A Yes vote enacts a 0.5% sales tax in the City of Palo Alto.

tax.text: A Yes vote enacts a 0.5% sales tax to provide approximately $15.6 million annually for general city services.
tax.quote: enacting a 0.5% (1/2¢) sales tax, providing approximately $15,600,000 annually until ended by voters

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed 0.5% sales tax.
tax.quote: enacting a 0.5% (1/2¢) sales tax, providing approximately $15,600,000 annually until ended by voters
